title: TARA: Carnatic EDM BGM, the high note drop (original score)
description:
What happens when a Carnatic singer's highest note lands on a festival drop? Tara is a Carnatic EDM track: rolling korvai-style rhythm builds count you in, the drop hits like a stadium, and the hook climbs to the high register (tara sthayi) where South Indian classical music saves its biggest moments.

Built for gym edits, travel reels, sports montages, dance videos and anyone who wants their EDM with a South Indian soul. Headphones on, volume up.

Music: Tara, an original score by ÆTHER. Composed for ÆTHER, made with AI.
